flows.description: When code changes are proposed, automatically assign multiple reviewer agents based on expertise. Reviewers vote on approval with weighted scores. Code merges only when consensus threshold is met (e.g., 80% approval).
key_steps: Code change detection triggers flow
Assign 3-5 reviewer agents based on code area expertise
Parallel review with scoring (1-10) and comments
Aggregate votes using reputation weighting
Auto-merge if threshold met, escalate if not
flows.value_proposition: Ensures code quality through democratic review while preventing bottlenecks. Leverages collective intelligence and builds trust in the codebase.

flows.description: User submits feature request, then Research → Architect → Coder → Tester → Reviewer agents collaborate asynchronously via message bus. Each agent publishes completion events that trigger the next stage automatically.
key_steps: User submits feature request to message bus topic
Researcher gathers requirements and publishes research findings
Architect subscribes to research topic, designs solution, publishes ADR
Coder implements based on ADR, publishes code artifacts
Tester runs tests, publishes results; Reviewer assesses quality
Auto-deployment if all quality gates pass
flows.value_proposition: Fully autonomous feature delivery without Primary AI coordination. Demonstrates true multi-agent collaboration using the new message bus infrastructure.

flows.description: Auditor agent continuously monitors system health metrics (test coverage, performance, errors). When degradation is detected, automatically triggers appropriate healing flows (e.g., spawn debugger agent, rollback changes, alert user).
key_steps: Auditor publishes health metrics to monitoring topic every hour
Anomaly detection on metrics (test coverage drop, error spike, etc.)
Trigger appropriate healing flow based on issue type
Execute remediation (rollback, debug, optimize)
Verify health restored, document incident
flows.value_proposition: Proactive system reliability without human intervention. Prevents small issues from becoming critical failures.

flows.description: Periodically analyze codebase architecture, identify technical debt and improvement opportunities. Propose refactoring plans, get democratic approval, then execute incremental refactoring with continuous validation to ensure no regressions.
key_steps: Architect analyzes codebase structure and identifies improvement areas
Create refactoring proposal with risk assessment and migration plan
Democratic vote on whether to proceed (all agents review impact)
Incremental refactoring with test validation at each step
Continuous deployment with automated rollback on failures
Document architectural evolution in ADR
flows.value_proposition: Prevents architectural erosion and keeps codebase healthy as system grows. Balances innovation with stability through democratic oversight.

flows.description: Automatically synthesize scattered knowledge from code comments, ADRs, commit messages, and agent logs into comprehensive, hierarchical documentation. Use AI to generate architecture diagrams, API references, and onboarding guides.
key_steps: Scan all knowledge sources (code, ADRs, logs, messages)
Extract key concepts, relationships, and patterns
Generate documentation hierarchy (overview → details → API ref)
Create visual diagrams (architecture, sequence, entity-relationship)
Publish to documentation site, keep synchronized with code changes
flows.value_proposition: Eliminates documentation drift and makes civilization knowledge accessible. Self-documenting system that grows with the codebase.

flows.description: Coordinate complex system upgrades (dependencies, framework versions, major refactors) with zero downtime using blue-green deployment, automated testing, and gradual rollout with real-time health monitoring.
key_steps: Create parallel 'green' environment with upgrades applied
Run comprehensive test suite on green environment
Gradual traffic shift (10% → 50% → 100%) with health monitoring
Automatic rollback if health metrics degrade
Complete cutover when green proven stable, decommission blue
flows.value_proposition: Allows safe evolution of civilization infrastructure without service interruptions. Critical for production reliability.

flows.description: Conduct comprehensive research on emerging AI agent frameworks, technologies, and best practices. Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations with periodic competitive intelligence reports to keep civilization cutting-edge.
key_steps: Define research questions and information needs
Multi-source research (academic papers, GitHub trends, documentation)
Comparative analysis with structured evaluation criteria
Synthesize findings into executive summary + detailed report
Identify actionable recommendations and capability gaps
Publish to knowledge base, trigger evolution proposals if needed
flows.value_proposition: Keeps civilization informed about industry trends and prevents reinventing the wheel. Identifies opportunities for strategic advantage.

flows.description: When facing complex, multi-faceted research questions, spawn a team of specialized researcher agents who divide the topic, research in parallel, then synthesize findings collaboratively via message bus.
key_steps: Decompose complex research question into sub-topics
Spawn/assign specialized researchers for each sub-topic
Parallel research with progress updates via pub-sub
Cross-pollination: researchers subscribe to each other's findings
Collaborative synthesis session to integrate insights
Produce unified research report with diverse perspectives
flows.value_proposition: Dramatically accelerates research on complex topics. Demonstrates advanced multi-agent collaboration and knowledge synthesis.

flows.description: As agents work, they continuously contribute to living documentation that evolves with the system. Every ADR, code change, and decision automatically updates relevant docs, with AI ensuring consistency and clarity.
key_steps: Agent makes code/architecture change
Automatically identify affected documentation sections
Generate documentation updates based on change context
Reviewer agent validates documentation clarity and accuracy
Publish updates, maintain version history and change log
flows.value_proposition: Documentation is always current and comprehensive without manual effort. Eliminates documentation debt and improves onboarding.

flows.description: AI-powered test generation that analyzes code, identifies untested paths and edge cases, then automatically generates comprehensive test suites. Continuously improves coverage toward 100% while maintaining test quality.
key_steps: Analyze codebase for coverage gaps using static analysis
Identify edge cases, error paths, and boundary conditions
Generate test cases using AI (property-based testing, fuzzing)
Reviewer validates test quality and relevance
Add tests to suite, track coverage improvement over time
flows.value_proposition: Achieves comprehensive test coverage without manual effort. Catches bugs proactively and improves code confidence.

flows.description: Continuous security scanning of code and dependencies. When vulnerabilities are detected, automatically research patches, test them in isolated environment, then propose secure updates with risk assessment.
key_steps: Continuous dependency and code security scanning
Vulnerability detection triggers alert on security topic
Research available patches and security advisories
Test patches in isolated sandbox environment
Generate security update PR with risk assessment
Democratic review and approval before deployment
flows.value_proposition: Proactive security posture without manual monitoring. Reduces vulnerability window and prevents security debt.

flows.description: Aggregate quality metrics (test coverage, code complexity, security vulnerabilities, performance) into real-time dashboard. Use trend analysis to predict quality degradation before it becomes critical.
key_steps: Collect metrics from all sources (tests, linters, profilers, security scanners)
Aggregate into unified quality dashboard with visualizations
Time-series analysis to identify trends (improving vs degrading)
Predictive alerts when metrics trending toward thresholds
Automated quality reports sent via email on schedule
Recommend interventions based on metric patterns
flows.value_proposition: Data-driven quality management with early warning system. Makes quality visible and actionable.

flows.description: Formal process for proposing, debating, and ratifying changes to the Constitutional CLAUDE.md. Requires supermajority (90% approval) and human ratification for sensitive changes to governance rules.
key_steps: Agent proposes constitutional amendment with detailed rationale
Public comment period: all agents can discuss and suggest edits
Refined amendment drafted based on feedback
Supermajority vote (90% threshold) with reputation weighting
Human approval required for final ratification
Update CLAUDE.md with versioning and changelog
flows.value_proposition: Enables civilization to evolve its governance while maintaining stability. Democratic but with appropriate safeguards for foundational rules.

flows.description: Intelligently allocate computational resources, agent availability, and task priorities based on current workload, deadlines, and strategic importance. Agents bid for resources in fair marketplace.
key_steps: Agents publish resource needs and task priorities
Resource allocation agent analyzes supply vs demand
Dynamic pricing/prioritization based on urgency and value
Allocate resources via auction or optimization algorithm
Monitor utilization, reallocate if bottlenecks detected
Track efficiency metrics and improve allocation strategy
flows.value_proposition: Optimal resource utilization and prevents starvation. Demonstrates economic coordination in multi-agent systems.

flows.description: When agents disagree on decisions or have conflicting goals, a formal mediation process with neutral arbitrator helps find consensus or escalates to democratic vote/human decision.
key_steps: Agents declare dispute and state their positions
Neutral mediator agent gathers facts and perspectives
Structured negotiation with compromise proposals
If consensus fails, escalate to full democratic vote
If still deadlocked, escalate to human decision
Document resolution and update policies to prevent recurrence
flows.value_proposition: Handles agent conflicts constructively without deadlocking the system. Builds institutional mechanisms for collaboration.

flows.description: When exploring new ideas, run rapid 2-hour prototyping sprint: minimal viable implementation, quick testing, demo to stakeholders, then decide whether to invest more or pivot.
key_steps: Define minimal prototype scope (core functionality only)
Time-boxed implementation (2 hours max)
Basic smoke tests to validate concept
Demo prototype with screenshots/video
Democratic vote: invest more, pivot, or abandon
Document learnings regardless of outcome
flows.value_proposition: Fast experimentation with low risk. Learn quickly what works before committing significant resources.

flows.description: Create extensible plugin architecture where agents can develop and share reusable components. Plugins registered in marketplace, versioned, and can be dynamically loaded by other agents.
key_steps: Define plugin API and packaging standards
Build plugin registry/marketplace system
Agents develop plugins following standards
Automated testing and security validation for new plugins
Publish to marketplace with documentation and examples
Track usage metrics and gather feedback for improvements
flows.value_proposition: Exponential capability growth through composability. Agents build on each other's work, creating ecosystem effects.

flows.description: When changes affect multiple components, automatically identify dependencies and run parallel builds/tests across components. Aggregate results and provide unified quality report.
key_steps: Analyze change scope and identify affected components
Build dependency graph and identify parallelizable work
Spawn multiple builder/tester agents for parallel execution
Aggregate build/test results via message bus
Report unified status with component-level details
Block deployment if any component fails
flows.value_proposition: Dramatically faster CI/CD pipeline. Scales with codebase size while maintaining quick feedback loops.

flows.description: Periodically identify, prioritize, and systematically eliminate technical debt. Democratic voting decides which debt to tackle, then focused sprint to clean up with comprehensive testing.
key_steps: Scan codebase for technical debt indicators (complexity, duplication, outdated patterns)
Catalog debt items with impact assessment and effort estimates
Democratic vote to prioritize top debt items
Focused sprint to refactor/modernize selected items
Comprehensive regression testing to ensure no breakage
Document improvements and update coding standards
flows.value_proposition: Prevents technical debt from accumulating and slowing development. Keeps codebase healthy and maintainable.

flows.description: Track all external dependencies, monitor for updates/security issues, automatically test upgrades in isolated environment, then propose upgrades with compatibility analysis.
key_steps: Continuous monitoring of dependency versions and security advisories
Automated testing of new versions in sandbox environment
Compatibility analysis and breaking change detection
Generate upgrade PR with test results and migration guide
Democratic review and approval
Staged rollout with health monitoring
flows.value_proposition: Stay current with ecosystem without manual tracking. Reduce security vulnerabilities and leverage latest features.

flows.description: Regular disaster recovery drills: simulate various failure scenarios, validate backups are restorable, time recovery process, identify gaps, then improve resilience based on findings.
key_steps: Define disaster scenarios (data corruption, service outage, security breach)
Execute simulated disaster in isolated environment
Attempt recovery using documented procedures
Measure recovery time and data loss
Identify process gaps and missing documentation
Update disaster recovery plan and backup strategies
Schedule next drill and track improvement over time
flows.value_proposition: Confidence that disaster recovery works before actual disaster strikes. Reduces downtime risk and data loss.

flows.description: Analyze civilization's current capabilities, identify strategic gaps, research emerging opportunities, then produce quarterly roadmap with prioritized initiatives aligned to long-term vision.
key_steps: Capability assessment: audit current agent skills and systems
Gap analysis: compare current vs desired future state
Opportunity research: identify emerging technologies and use cases
Strategic prioritization: value vs effort matrix
Produce quarterly roadmap with milestones
Democratic approval, then execute top priorities
flows.value_proposition: Proactive strategic planning prevents reactive firefighting. Aligns civilization efforts toward cohesive vision.

flows.description: When capability gaps are identified, systematically address them: research solutions, evaluate build vs integrate, execute implementation, validate effectiveness, then iterate based on results.
key_steps: Capability gap identified (from strategic planning or incidents)
Research potential solutions (new agents, integrations, training)
Evaluate options with ROI analysis (build vs buy vs partner)
Execute selected approach (spawn agent, integrate API, etc.)
Validate capability meets requirements via benchmarks
Iterate if needed, document success/failure for learning
flows.value_proposition: Systematic capability development prevents ad-hoc additions. Builds institutional knowledge about what works.

flows.description: Revolutionary self-improvement: flows analyze their own execution data, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, propose optimizations, then automatically evolve to become more efficient over time.
key_steps: Instrument all flows with performance metrics (duration, cost, quality)
Analyze execution data to identify patterns and bottlenecks
AI generates optimization proposals (parallelize steps, skip redundant work)
Simulate optimized flow to predict improvement
A/B test original vs optimized flow
Auto-adopt optimized version if metrics improve, iterate
flows.value_proposition: Self-improving civilization that gets better over time without human intervention. Meta-level intelligence applied to process optimization.

flows.description: Streamline integration with external services: provide API credentials and documentation, then automated flow generates client library, tests, documentation, and integration examples.
key_steps: Provide API documentation and authentication credentials
Auto-generate client library from OpenAPI/Swagger spec
Create comprehensive test suite with mocking
Generate usage examples and integration documentation
Security review for credential handling and data privacy
Publish integration package to civilization's API registry
flows.value_proposition: Rapid integration with external services without repetitive boilerplate. Enables powerful ecosystem connections.

flows.description: Package and deploy applications to multiple platforms (Docker, cloud functions, edge devices) with platform-specific optimizations, all from single codebase using automated build matrix.
key_steps: Configure deployment targets (AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Run, Docker, etc.)
Platform-specific build optimizations (bundle size, runtime)
Parallel deployment to all target platforms
Platform-specific smoke tests to validate deployment
Unified monitoring dashboard across all platforms
Rollback capability with platform-specific strategies
flows.value_proposition: Deploy everywhere without platform-specific code. Maximizes application reach and deployment flexibility.

flows.description: Systematically collect user feedback from multiple channels (email, GitHub issues, usage metrics), aggregate insights, identify top pain points, then prioritize improvements democratically.
key_steps: Aggregate feedback from all sources (emails, issues, metrics, surveys)
AI-powered sentiment analysis and theme extraction
Cluster feedback into categories (bugs, features, UX issues)
Prioritize by impact (frequency × severity × effort)
Present top issues to agents for democratic prioritization
Track resolution and close feedback loop with users
flows.value_proposition: User-centric development driven by actual needs rather than assumptions. Builds user trust and product-market fit.

flows.description: Automated accessibility testing across all user interfaces (CLI, web, email). Identify WCAG compliance gaps, propose fixes, validate improvements, ensure civilization is inclusive by design.
key_steps: Automated accessibility scanning (screen readers, keyboard nav, contrast)
Manual accessibility testing with diverse user personas
Catalog violations with severity and remediation guidance
Implement fixes following accessibility best practices
Regression testing to prevent accessibility debt
Publish accessibility statement and conformance report
flows.value_proposition: Ensures civilization is accessible to all users. Demonstrates ethical AI development and legal compliance.
